environment.rationale: Use separately prepared, pinned CPU runtime image; [] suppresses implicit uv sync and Iris runtime setup. This requires all dependencies already installed and verified, including any callable runner dependencies.

submission_mapping.entrypoint: Prepared worker_main.py CLI defaults to read-only preflight; --execute invokes diagnostic only with resolved declared bindings and fresh output directory. No submitter supplied; execution still requires explicit authorization.
submission_mapping.default_preemption_retry_note: Signature says 1000 while prose docstring says 100; omit override and bind actual installed controller/client revisions.
submission_mapping.coscheduling: Do not copy tpu-name grouping: CoschedulingConfig groups workers by shared attribute, not a distinct-host requirement. CPU concurrency/placement must be reviewed with chosen region before execution.

import_and_bundle_gaps: Selected solution: self-contained candidate Git clone in the future CPU image; worker preflight uses same commit/byte validation. Actual image/digest/build and checkout inclusion remain unverified.
Worker interpreter and CPU-only dependency lock/image digest unresolved. setup_scripts=[] alone is not environment qualification.

Worker bootstrap prepends candidate Levanter/Iris source roots and verifies top-level origins via PathFinder without importing packages; rejects preloaded Iris/Levanter/JAX. Post-import per-module checks remain. Custom meta finders and transitive packages are not exhaustively attested.
Harness and trace_contract must be included in pinned bundle, with import origin checks. Four scripts passing lint does not prove deployment packaging.
ONLINE native initialization precedes Levanter/JAX imports, but W&B and transitive imports can execute code; real package initialization remains unqualified.
fresh_attempt_evidence: New job identity per scenario, random native run id per process, resume=never, exclusive local trace directory per attempt.
Initializer source keys coordinator endpoint by task-zero attempt number. Peers query task-zero current attempt, not their own attempt number.
Capture actual task-zero attempt/service endpoint evidence separately for each future attempt. A local suffix prediction is not proof of actual registry freshness or cleanup.
No registry proxy, additional service calls or barriers added to candidate. Existing endpoint unregister is an atexit hook; its actual ordering/lifetime must be observed in runtime qualification.
open_deployment_bindings: immutable CPU runtime image and dependency lock
retention: CPU-only proposed first stage changes no existing accelerator allocation. It does not resolve accelerator retention for later TPU/GPU qualification.
source_checkout_policy: Future pinned CPU image must contain a self-contained Git clone at a fixed candidate-root path, with exact candidate commit objects available to git show and matching working files. Do not copy the isolated worktree .git pointer or shared .venv. Image construction/install is not performed by this preparation.
